# These are some of the businesses that have been with us from the beginning!

**We went to explore the fair to find two of the businesses that have been participating in this event the longest. They are Dulces Típicos D'Isa @disadulces and Las Rellenitas, who have been coming every semester for over a decade and have seen several generations of Tutors come and go, forging a bond that has lasted over time.**

**We talked to them about what participating in this fair has meant for the growth of their businesses and what they like most about interacting with our community.**

###### EAFIT and Ecopetrol identify opportunities to strengthen sustainable water management in Colombia

What to do with large volumes of water that are currently discarded and how to turn them into a reserve for the future? That was one of the questions that motivated an interdisciplinary team of researchers from EAFIT to develop, together with Ecopetrol, a pioneering project in Colombia.

[Read more](https://www.eafit.edu.co/noticias/nuestro-impacto/eafit-y-ecopetrol-identifican-oportunidades-para-fortalecer-la-gestion "Read more")

[Institutional](https://www.eafit.edu.co/taxonomy/term/1846)

###### Leading is also about learning to care

There are professional decisions that have a direct impact on people's lives. Carlos Alberto Lozano Muñetón, a graduate of the Master of Business Administration (MBA) program at EAFIT and CEO of Clínica Cardio VID, shares what he learns from leading this healthcare organization.

[Read more](https://www.eafit.edu.co/noticias/nuestra-comunidad-de-talento/liderar-tambien-es-aprender-cuidar "Read more")

October 19, 2026

![Image: This is how networking allows you to build valuable relationships](https://universidadeafit.widen.net/content/40cca8a0-ecc7-447e-b6c1-fd27bcbf069c/web/networking-20-10-2026.jpg?crop=yes&k=c&w=823&h=450&itok=jqikyokk)

[Companies and businesses](https://www.eafit.edu.co/taxonomy/term/1856)

###### This is how networking allows you to build valuable relationships

A conversation can lead us to learn about a company, discover a job opportunity, or understand a problem from a perspective we hadn't considered. Sometimes, simply sitting down with someone from another profession, listening to their experience, and sharing our own is enough to find common ground or open the door to new possibilities.

[Read more](https://www.eafit.edu.co/noticias/nuestra-comunidad-de-talento/asi-es-como-el-networking-permite-construir-relaciones-de "Read more")
